breakwave_statement.text: The VLCC futures curve is currently in steep backwardation, reflecting market expectations of an eventual resolution, with third-quarter futures trading at a nearly 50% discount to the current TD3C Index.

events.text: Iran closes the Strait of Hormuz

events.source: Baltic Exchange circular 17/26, as reported in its weekly tanker reports
events.text: TD34 (270,000 t Mina Al Fahal to Ningbo) on public trial

weekly.note: While the Straits of Hormuz are not officially closed and the risk remains heightened, Baltic’s panellists feel able to price Middle East loading for the crude oil shipping market.
At present, our panellists remain able to price Middle East loading for the Crude Oil shipping market.
The extreme risk to shipping via the Strait of Hormuz still exists, however, our panellists remain able to price Middle East loading for the Crude Oil shipping market.
VLCC The ongoing situation in the Middle East is still causing the Baltic panellists some difficulties in assessing the Baltic routes from the region.
Transits through the Straits of Hormuz are extremely limited still, with owners and charterers seemingly unwilling to risk it.
VLCC Transits through the Straits of Hormuz remain limited, with reports this week of a blockade by the US Navy.
VLCC The Middle East situation continues with both the US and Iran claiming the Strait of Hormuz blocked, followed by reports of vessels transiting.
